ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOP = \angle BOP = 15^\circ$, $PC \parallel OA$, $PD \perp OA$, $PE \perp OB$. If $PC = 4$, what is the length of $PD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $PC \parallel OA$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOP = \angle CPO = 15^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle PCE = \angle BOP + \angle CPO = 15^\circ + 15^\circ = 30^\circ$,\\
and since $PC = 4$,\\
it follows that $PE = \frac{1}{2}PC = \frac{1}{2} \times 4 = 2$,\\
since $\angle AOP = \angle BOP$, $PD \perp OA$, $PE \perp OB$,\\
it follows that $PD = PE = \boxed{2}$.
